description: The text of a PDF as clean Markdown, ready for an AI to read, search or quote (RAG): headings, lists and tables kept, columns in reading order, a running header or footer once. Scanned pages are read with OCR (Vietnamese, English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean), up to 40 scanned pages a file. Text set in the old Vietnamese fonts (TCVN3, VNI) comes out in Unicode. Up to 500 pages and 25 MB. Free, 50 files a day per account. A result up to 20,000 characters comes back here in full; a longer one as a link to the .md file (24 hours) with its beginning.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the PDF there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the PDF. A result link from another Yangopen tool works too.

page_marks.description: Put <!-- page N --> before each page, so a quote can name its page.

name: pdf_to_markdown
title: Turn a PDF into Markdown
